“I thought cardio looked good, decision making looked good, and activity was good.”

quote.author: Bobby Krivitsky
quote.text:
Jayson Tatum on how it felt to be back out there feeling like his normal self:

He had 23 points, 5 rebounds, 4 assists, and 1 steal:

“Just to be back in the normal flow of the season and going through the normal reps. I was really happy to kind of just be a part of it today. Kind of feel normal.”
